questions.stem: A 6-year-old child from northern part of Russia is brought to the paediatrician with complaints of pain in the legs and difficulty walking. As they were in their tour to Goa, they wanted to treat their child as early as possible and need to return to their country before their visa expires. On taking history, the child has been exclusively breastfed and does not receive any sunlight exposure due to climatic conditions over there. What is the most likely diagnosis based on the history of this patient?
